Fair Deal Property Your Trusted Partners for Residential Property Sales

Are delighted to present to you for sale No. 44 Fearann Rí.

Ideally located in the heart of the popular residential area of Doughiska, No. 44 Fearann Rí is a bright and exceptionally spacious four-bedroom semi-detached home extending to approximately 104 sq. m. With its generous proportions, excellent layout and highly sought-after location, this property represents an excellent opportunity for first-time buyers and growing families alike. This is an owner occupied home which makes it an ideal investment opportunity.

The accommodation is well laid out and offers an abundance of living space throughout. On entering the property, the bright entrance hall leads through to a particularly spacious sitting room, which enjoys excellent natural light and feature fireplace, creating a comfortable and welcoming main living space.

To the rear is a generously proportioned kitchen/dining room, offering excellent floor space and a pleasant outlook over the fully enclosed rear garden. An ideal sized utility/rear entrance area and guest WC complete the ground floor accommodation.

Upstairs, there are four well-presented bedrooms, comprising two double bedrooms and two single bedrooms. The master bedroom benefits from its own ensuite, while the remaining bedrooms provide excellent flexibility for family living, guests or home-working requirements. A main family bathroom, hot press and linen storage complete the first-floor accommodation.

Externally, the property benefits from off-street parking for two cars to the front, while the fully enclosed rear garden provides a private outdoor space with excellent potential for family use, entertaining or further landscaping.

No. 44 Fearann Rí enjoys an enviable location within Doughiska, close to many of Galway City’s major employment hubs. Parkmore, Ballybrit and Mervue Industrial Estates are all within easy reach and are home to a host of leading medical device, technology and multinational employers. The area also benefits from excellent transport links and regular bus routes providing convenient access to Galway City and surrounding suburbs, together with easy access to the M6 and M18 motorway network.

With four bedrooms, generous living accommodation, private parking and an excellent location, No. 44 Fearann Rí offers exceptional value in today’s Galway property market. For buyers seeking a spacious family home in a well-established and highly convenient residential area, this property is certainly worthy of consideration.

If you are looking for a very well-located four-bedroom home that offers an abundance of space and represents outstanding value, we suggest you look no further than No. 44 Fearann Rí.

If this sounds like the property for you, we’d be delighted to hear from you and help in any way that we can.
